method: The Shell's local word lookup over real recognized lines: file reads (what they fetch), bytes, deinflection candidates generated / searched / found, the arena peak and the time, per lookup and per screen, with a console latency model. Compares two builds or dictionaries and fails unless every lookup shows exactly the same entries (a golden check).

console_model.source: estimate: least-squares fit over the 57 distinct lookups of the v0.8.0-test.2 console log.txt, whose first 4,966 lines are test.1's whole log (ms = 21.9 + 3.73 x reads, R^2 0.52, reads 5-33). By kind: cursor (n 35) 11.2 + 3.76 x reads, R^2 0.85; first word and on open (n 22) 35.4 + 3.91 x reads, R^2 0.27. docs/performance.md's 30-lookup fit: 15.3 + 3.82. A read's bytes beyond 4 KiB at most 0.146 ms/KiB: the 1,155,968 B of VOCR3-H15 weights in 32 KiB reads took at most 165 ms (load 218-231 ms less the A9 SHA-256 estimate)
